label_rationale: releaseAll and lock share a nonReentrant lock held across the call
mechanism: escrow desk: depositors release their escrowed funds
arm_reason: a state-changing callback with a user/frozen target; the general assume-guarantee arm applies

closure.justification: functions whose read/write effects intersect the proof footprint ['_status', 'committed', 'escrowed', 'held']

ghost_state.name: inFlight
ghost_state.meaning: payout sent to the caller whose committed and escrowed updates are deferred past the call

composition.rule: admissible callbacks preserve I_exp; the post-phase restores I_stable, which implies phi

mcvp_rounds.ag_spec_rendered:
Assume-Guarantee specification for EscrowDesk_CR04a
  target property phi : held >= committed
  exposure site       : releaseAll.call  (low-level call)
  ghost state         : uint256 inFlight

  [A_cb]  ASSUMPTION
          During releaseAll's exposed phase, re-entrant control is confined to the
          callback closure ['lock', 'releaseAll']; every such callback is admitted by the
          protocol, with bounded depth-one nesting.
          discharged by: conservative-closure soundness gate (static, not the LLM)

  [G_pre] GUARANTEE
          {held >= committed && _status == 1} pre-phase {held + inFlight >= committed && escrowed[caller] >= inFlight && _status == 2}
          discharged by: OBL_pre

  [G_exp] GUARANTEE
          forall f in A_cb. {I_exp} f {I_exp}   (I_exp = held + inFlight >= committed && escrowed[caller] >= inFlight && _status == 2)
          discharged by: ['OBL_cb_lock', 'OBL_cb_releaseAll']

  [G_post] GUARANTEE
          {I_exp} post-phase {held >= committed && _status == 1 /\ inFlight==0}
          discharged by: OBL_post

  COMPOSITION THEOREM (instance):
    A_cb => (G_pre /\ G_exp /\ G_post) => held >= committed
      where callbacks are confined to admissible_callbacks=['lock', 'releaseAll'], depth-one

obligations.purpose: callback lock preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)

obligations.purpose: callback releaseAll preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)
